title: ZINQ LTD: first look

claims.text: ZINQ is an AI agent platform that automates customer conversations and workflows, which is in line with the fund's AI focus.
The company is classed as B2B SaaS, one of the two sectors most represented in the fund's listed portfolio.
The company is based in the UK, which falls within the fund's European coverage.
The fund's listed themes include AI agents and agentic economy, which matches ZINQ's product description.
ZINQ offers a multi-channel platform covering WhatsApp, web chat, Instagram, Telegram, email and phone, combining AI agents with human handoff.
ZINQ shows an early traction signal: a Crunchbase growth score of 88 and a heat score of 90.
The company is listed as founded in 2025, so it is at a very early stage that fits the fund's seed focus.
The dataset shows no funding rounds, so the company's current funding status is unclear.
Crunchbase lists the company as having 1-10 employees, which suggests a very small team.
PitchBook gives a founding year of 2024, which conflicts with the 2025 founding year in our dataset.
PitchBook records a latest deal type of PE Growth, which does not match a pre-seed profile and needs checking.
The product is described as being used across many industries, so it is unclear whether the company has a focused market.
The product listing shows 1 review and about 308 followers, so there is limited independent evidence of adoption.
